_doc: Declared runtime-state tracked files that must NOT gate the worktree_isolation ff-only-pull exception (PENDING-ARMS 'Pro main self-align strutturalmente chiuso', opened 2026-07-06, iteration 5). These are files that are TRACKED in git (so plain untracked-file exclusion doesn't cover them) but are CONTINUOUSLY rewritten by live runtime processes on a specific machine — cron logs, published-content indices, generated reference docs, append-only hook ledgers. A tracked-dirty repo normally shuts the ff-only exception (fail-closed default: any tracked mutation might collide with an incoming fast-forward). The files below are the DECLARED exception, each scoped to the machines whose live writers actually dirty it: dirty-but-expected runtime residue, never a sibling's in-flight edit. Anything NOT on this list still gates the exception exactly as before (W91 lesson: an exception is a guard with inverted sign — it needs its OWN guilt+innocence proof, not just an innocence case). Consumed by worktree_isolation._main_tree_tracked_clean(). Paths are REPO-RELATIVE (matched against `git status --porcelain` path column, exact match only — no globs, no prefix match, so a NEW file under the same directory does NOT silently inherit the allowlist).

entries.reason: cron/agent escalation append-log. Appended by automation on EVERY host, not only Pro: on 2026-09-26 M5 main (11 lines) and Mini main were dirty with it, and the Pro-only scope left M5 unable to ff-only its own main (the guard fail-closed on a file upstream never touched). Widened to m5+mini the same day

prod-hotfix audit ledger, appended by ~/.claude/scripts/hotfix-notify.sh, which the PostToolUse Bash hook bash_call_log.sh invokes on every Bash call; it appends one line to <git toplevel of the session cwd>/shared/hotfix_audit.jsonl whenever a command is hotfix-shaped (fly ssh + DDL/DML, fly secrets set, fly machines restart/destroy/stop). The notifier and the hook are installed identically on all three hosts, so any session whose cwd is main dirties it. Observed 2026-09-26: 3 uncommitted lines on M5 main, all from sessions with cwd=/Users/balizero/nuzantara

WR2/article-composer publish-state index, rewritten on every publish cycle. FULL repo-relative path — the consumer (worktree_isolation._main_tree_tracked_clean) matches the `git status --porcelain` path column by EXACT string, and porcelain always emits the deep path; a bare `published_articles.json` here matched NOTHING (W91: the exception silently did not cover the always-dirty file it existed to cover — corrected 2026-07-16)
generated automations reference doc, regenerated by a Pro-side doc-sync cron
